summary: Replaced separate M10/M15 device claims with one App-managed maintenance coordinator and added M16 typed latest-operation persistence, recovery semantics, expected-disruption structure, and deterministic regression coverage without a package-execution path.
completed: Migrated M10 administration and M15 update checks to DeviceMaintenanceCoordinator; M16 UpdateApply/recovery claim kinds are reserved in the same all-to-all per-device conflict matrix.

Added a bounded, atomic, latest-per-device MaintenanceOperation record to state.json with generated unit identity, plan fingerprint field, dispatch distinction, lifecycle/failure states, and backward-compatible defaults.
Added read-only typed get_maintenance_operation Tauri surface; no command creates or dispatches a maintenance operation yet.
Extended expected-disruption typing for M16 UpdateDevice with operation-scoped cleanup and expiry; Activity event construction is structural only and is not appended before execution exists.
Added deterministic coordination, lifecycle persistence/reload, legacy-state, raw-output exclusion, and bounded expected-disruption coverage.

validationCommands.summary: 245 passed, 1 ignored; includes M10/M15 regressions and all new deterministic state/coordinator tests.
TypeScript and Vite production build passed.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Same-device conflicts are rejected by one authority
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: DeviceMaintenanceCoordinator holds M10 administration, M15 checking, and reserved M16 apply/recovery kinds in one RAII all-to-all device claim map.
Atomic state.json persistence reloads every frozen lifecycle state and distinguishes not-attempted, accepted, and uncertain dispatch.
No apt-get update/upgrade or systemd-run RemoteOperation, command, dispatch path, or live-device validation was added or run.

notes: Risk score: 42/100 (medium): shared concurrency and durable state changed, but no remote package state or systemd unit was touched.
WU16-03 remains the owner of fixed APT/systemd operations, actual preflight/dispatch/recovery execution, verification, and runtime Activity emission.
